## D — Accuracy and source flags: Space management and communication

Source basis: every knowledge block names one physical page of the hash-bound South Dakota handbook; the sentence is paraphrased and is not an official question.
A separate same-model fact-check receipt records each draft fact and its qualifier review before outbox submission; independent factual QA remains pending.
Preserve approximate passing calculations, worst-hazard space choice, horn exceptions for intersection users/blind pedestrians/animals, beam-distance inequalities, truck blind-area bounds, signal timing caveats and antique-vehicle date. [A52] [A53] [A54] [A55] [A56]
The cover lacks extracted text and is not visually cleared. The edition observation is on the back matter; no image-only content was converted into a learner fact.
Unknown official exam statistics remain null. No legal or clinical opinion is asserted beyond the official handbook’s own driving guidance.

corpus_stability.reason: The official dated snapshot is pinned, but revision frequency has not been measured. Unknown cadence remains blocked for release pending the section-A verification debt; this is not a claim that the handbook is volatile.
